verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online is a SaaS product with AI features (Intuit AI, Intuit Intelligence, Payroll AI), so a buyer can reasonably ask whether their data can be kept out of AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a data-use privacy policy. The MCP server's write-disable toggles and sandbox environments concern agent permissions, not training-data opt-out.
